facts.material: pantoprazole sodium (proton pump inhibitor), unmixed active ingredient with excipients
facts.function: therapeutic medicament reducing gastric acid (erosive esophagitis, hypersecretion)
facts.form: 20 mg and 40 mg delayed-release tablets (measured doses)
facts.end_use: human medical treatment of digestive disorders

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3004 covers medicaments for therapeutic use put up in measured doses; tablets are measured doses; not 3003 (bulk) nor 2933 (bulk chemical)
GRI 6: 3004.90 other (not antibiotics, hormones, alkaloids, vitamins of 3004.10-3004.60), 3004.90.92 other
GRI 6: statistical suffix under Medicaments primarily affecting the digestive system: Containing pantoprazole or its salts (current 2026 Rev 20 tree, 3004.90.92.55)

rejected_alternatives.reason: bulk pantoprazole sodium is a chapter 29 chemical; here it is put up in dosage form
suffix cited in N356509/N337151 under the earlier 2026 Basic tree; in the current revision .57 is glycopyrrolate and pantoprazole moved to .55
residual digestive-system suffix; a specific pantoprazole line exists

classification.rationale: Pantoprazole sodium delayed-release tablets are medicaments in measured doses of heading 3004, falling in 3004.90.92 as other medicaments. NY N356509 (in force) classified pantoprazole sodium tablets in 3004.90.92 under the pantoprazole statistical line. The current revision's tree lists 'Containing pantoprazole or its salts' at 3004.90.92.55 (a revision diff shows the line was .57 in the 2026 Basic edition), so .55 is used.
